jobs.occupation: Head of Enterprise Integrations - Troax AB
jobs.description:
Head of Enterprise Integrations
Do you want to shape how systems, applications and data connect across a global organization? Troax is strengthening its global IT organization and establishing Enterprise Integration as a core capability. We are now looking for a Head of Enterprise Integrations who wants to take a key role in this transformation and build the integration capability that will support Troax’s continued development.
The position has a global scope and is primarily based in Jönköping, with the possibility of being based at another Troax office in Sweden. 

Linus, VP of IT, shares what it’s like to work at Troax
"What makes this an exciting time to join Troax is that we are building and developing several important capabilities within IT. There is a real opportunity to come in, take ownership and help shape both the direction and how we work going forward. At the same time, you are close to the business and can see how your work contributes to a global industrial company with a clear purpose and products that create real value for customers.
For me, a good working environment is built on clarity, trust and open dialogue. I want people to feel involved, understand the bigger picture and have the freedom to take responsibility and influence how we work. If you enjoy building something new, collaborating across an international organization and seeing tangible progress from your work, Troax offers a very exciting environment.”
About the role
You will be given the mandate to shape the integration landscape from the ground up, creating the structures, standards and technical foundation needed to connect applications, platforms, data and external partners across the organization.
Your mission is to establish a scalable, secure and governed approach to integration across Troax. You will define the vision, strategy and roadmap while building the structures and standards needed for a modern integration landscape. An important part of the role will be to establish and own a common integration platform and create clear principles for how integrations are developed, monitored, documented and managed throughout their lifecycle.
You will work across business and IT, collaborating closely with system and process owners, regional IT, external partners and specialists within areas such as Architecture, Data, AI & Automation and Business Applications.
Key responsibilities:
Define and drive the Enterprise Integration vision, strategy and roadmap.
Establish and own a Group-wide integration platform.
Establish principles, standards, reusable patterns and governance for integration development.
Develop lifecycle management, documentation, monitoring, support and follow-up.
Ensure scalable, secure, robust and traceable integrations.
Coordinate internal capabilities and external integration and development partners.
Contribute to the future sourcing model for integration capabilities.
Support larger business transformation and system initiatives across the Group.

Meet Elin, Software Developer at Troax.
"What I really enjoy about working at Troax is the people and the atmosphere. There is a lot of knowledge and competence here, but at the same time the environment is very open, friendly and down-to-earth. You can be in the middle of a serious discussion about a complex system and still have room for laughter and a relaxed conversation.
I also really appreciate how close you are to the actual business. For me, the connection between software development and the physical factory was something that stood out from the beginning. There is a real sense of potential here, with many opportunities to improve, develop and make a difference. And perhaps most importantly, it is simply a workplace where I genuinely enjoy spending time with my colleagues.”
Your profile
We are looking for a senior profile with experience in establishing or developing integration capabilities. Your background could be within integration architecture, enterprise architecture, platform ownership, IT leadership or technical delivery.
As a person, you are self-driven and structured with a strong sense of ownership. You communicate confidently with both technical and business stakeholders and have the ability to explain complex topics in a clear and accessible way. You enjoy collaborating with others but are equally comfortable making decisions and driving your area forward.
We believe you bring:
Experience establishing or developing Enterprise Integration in a larger or complex organization.
Strong understanding of integration architecture and integration platforms.
Experience with API management, application and system integration and information flows.
Knowledge of integration patterns, monitoring, documentation, security and lifecycle management.
Ability to define target states, principles, standards and roadmaps.
Experience coordinating and setting requirements for external technology partners.
The ability to combine strategic responsibility with operational execution.
Very good command of English, both written and spoken. Swedish is an advantage but not a requirement.

Contact and application
In this recruitment we are collaborating with recruitment consultants Maria Ahlén, 0708-490 288, and Malou Magnusson, 0707-588745, at Intenso Teknikrekrytering.
We review applications continuously, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please submit your application using the application button. 
We look forward to receiving your application!

About Troax Group
At Troax Group, we believe that safety makes progress possible. We help businesses protect people, property and processes through a broad portfolio of industrial safety solutions and services. From machine guarding and warehouse safety to data centre protection, active safety, risk assessments and expert services, we work with our customers to understand their challenges and create safer, more productive environments. Founded in Sweden, Troax has grown into a global group with operations in around 40 countries and approximately 1,400 employees. For seven decades, we have combined deep safety expertise with innovation and a strong customer focus. Our purpose is simple: to make the world safer, every day. Read more at www.troax.com.

The final phase of a delivery is where our technology truly proves itself. Installation at the shipyard, commissioning, HAT and SAT, final acceptance, and the warranty period are critical stages in ensuring that the vessel performs as promised. They are also the moments that shape the customer’s lasting impression of our delivery.
To strengthen our focus on this critical phase, we are now establishing a new Commissioning & Warranty function and are looking for two individuals to join the team who want to help shape it from the start. In this role, you will take operational responsibility for the delivery through its most decisive stage, where engineering is transformed into real-world performance and customer value.
What you will be doing
As Responsible for Commissioning & Warranty, you are operationally responsible for a delivery from formal project handover, after FAT and delivery of the equipment, until the customer is transferred to standard Aftermarket support. You will plan, coordinate, and drive the delivery forward through arrival inspection, installation support, commissioning, HAT and SAT, customer acceptance, the warranty period, and ultimately formal warranty closure. Your mission is clear: keep everything moving until we leave behind vessels that perform as promised and customers who trust us to deliver again.
Throughout this journey, you will be the customer’s primary operational point of contact, providing continuity, direction, and clear ownership from one phase to the next. Internally, you will be the connecting force between our technical, operational, and supporting functions, bringing the right people together, aligning priorities, and ensuring that the delivery continues to move forward.
In practice, you will:
Take over the delivery from the Project Manager and make sure nothing falls between the two of you: scope, open points, documentation and warranty terms.
Coordinate field service resources and spare parts, and collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), technical support and suppliers to secure competence and availability against plan;
Ensure arrival inspection at site is completed and drive transport damage and shortages to resolution.
Support installation towards the shipyard, then plan and run commissioning, HAT and SAT until acceptance is obtained.
Act as operational owner of warranty cases, from registration and technical assessment to liability determination and resolution, including claim handling and supplier recovery.
Handle customer disputes and negotiate practical, commercially sound settlements within your mandate.
Keep scope boundaries, documentation, cost exposure and status visible and feed lessons learned back into engineering, production and service.

You work within a clear mandate. Decisions on prioritization, technical resolution paths, resourcing, warranty assessment and settlements within your delegated authority are yours to make. The Project Manager remains accountable for the overall project, and the genuinely large questions are escalated but you are expected to solve, not to forward.
We think you should have
You have led projects before and know what it takes to keep stakeholders aligned when schedules are under pressure. You are comfortable being the main point of contact for customers and enjoy balancing technical, commercial and operational perspectives to move a project forward.
We believe you have several years of experience in project management, commissioning management, or aftermarket/service management, preferably within the marine, offshore, energy, or other capital equipment industries. You hold a technical degree or have gained equivalent knowledge through practical experience. You have worked closely with shipyards, customers and suppliers, handling deviations, claims and commercial discussions, and you possess a solid technical understanding that allows you to actively participate in discussions with engineers and service technicians, form your own view of technical challenges, and contribute to finding solutions.
You are comfortable working across multiple IT systems simultaneously, such as ERP platforms, case and claim management systems, documentation tools and reporting solutions. You also have a good understanding of contracts, warranty terms and the commercial impact of technical decisions. Fluency in English, both written and spoken, is required, while Swedish is considered an advantage. The role also involves occasional travel to shipyards, vessels and customer sites as needed, although travel is not the primary focus of the position.
Just as important as your experience is the way you work. You are structured and proactive, with a natural ability to bring tasks to completion rather than letting them drift. You remain calm and professional in challenging situations, focusing on finding solutions and building strong relationships. You communicate clearly with people from different cultures, backgrounds and levels of an organization, and you take ownership of your responsibilities without waiting to be directed.
Why join us
A role with real influence. Commissioning and warranty is where our promises to the customer are tested. We are building a clearer, more structured and more customer-focused way of working around it and you will help us shape it. Your work strengthens the transition between New Sales, Project Management and the Aftermarket organization, with better quality, stronger documentation, reduced cost leakage and stronger customer relationships as the result.
A global and technologically advanced environment. World-leading products for vessel propulsion, experienced colleagues and international customers. You will work closely with Project Management, Technical Support, Field Service, Engineering, our Product Centers and the regional Global Customer Support organizations, and build a cross-functional network across the business that few other roles give you.
Breadth, and room to grow. Few positions combine technology, coordination, customer dialogue, business understanding and continuous improvement the way this one does. It sits in a stable global organization with a strong culture of innovation, and offers good development opportunities in whichever direction you want to take next.
We offer flexible working hours and the option to work remote or from home office.

Security Clearance is required for this position.
Kongsberg Maritime - a global leader in maritime technology.

Description
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. 

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. 

We are currently seeking a Data Center Engineering Operations Technician to serve as a technical resource within our mission critical Data Center’s. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels of Data Center Engineering Operations. We strive towards building a diverse workforce and look to hire the best people we can regardless of age, gender or ethnicity.

 Due to the success of the Amazon Web Services (AWS) operations and rapid expansion of Data Centers we are recruiting suitable candidates to operate/maintain these facilities in Sweden. In this role you will have a positive involvement in both the maintenance of facilities and the improvement of efficiencies to help offer Amazon customer’s better value.
 

Key job responsibilities
 You will also be involved in:
 o Assisting in the operation and maintenance of all electrical, mechanical, fire/life safety equipment and HVAC equipment within the Data Center/Facility. This equipment supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime.
 o Assisting in the maintenance and monitoring of all Data Center systems to include incidents/events, problems, changes, monitoring, problem escalation/notification/resolution and all other aspects of Data Center support.
 o Monitoring and troubleshooting all mechanical, electrical, HVAC systems, voice/data, cooling systems, fire/life safety equipment and generators.
 o Providing assistance to contractor or data center engineers to ensure proper operation and maintenance of all facility equipment.
 o Providing assistance to contractors or data center engineers to deploy new equipment, such as building racks, cabling, and other tasks as necessary.
 o Performing site walk throughs to verify proper operation of Facility Equipment and Monitoring Systems.
 
 In addition to acting as a Facilities First Responder to critical events, you will be a part of the team supporting new data center facilities and existing data center facilities!

A day in the life
Day to day activities for this role include; 
 o Monitoring of all alarms and systems involved in the operation of power, cooling and fire suppression systems in the data center. 
 o Planning and coordinating vendor works on site to ensure equipment is maintained and uptime retained. 
 o Supporting other sites and teams during events and planned works. 
 o Carrying out rack power up and installation duties. 
 o Monitoring and facilitating new equipment handover. 
 o Supporting new hires and team members through knowledge share and development. 
 o Event response and drill participation. 

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. 

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Basic Qualifications
- Electrical, mechanical or instrumentation training and/or relevant experience
- 2+ years of relevant work experience
- Strong English verbal and written communication skills
Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in data center engineering

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.occupation: Professional Home Cleaner at HomeWork® AB
jobs.description:
SVENSKA NEDAN / SWEDISH BELOW
Professional Home Cleaner at HomeWork® AB
HomeWork® AB is one of Sweden's largest home cleaning companies, with clients in Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, and Lund. We have focused exclusively on home cleaning since 2007, that is, for more than 19 years.
As a professional home cleaner with HomeWork, you clean the homes of regular clients on a weekly, biweekly, or four-weekly basis. You normally have two clients a day, sometimes three, but never more. The clients stay the same over time, so they become your clients, who know you and trust you.
We're looking for employees who are motivated and genuinely skilled in home cleaning: who know their materials and methods, work meticulously and efficiently, stay organized, and have an eye for detail. Strong communication, service-mindedness, and a sense of responsibility are also important. If you have previous professional cleaning experience it’s an advantage, but not a requirement.
Since we only recruit people who want home cleaning to be their profession, we ask that you work at least 25% of full-time, that is, 10 hours per week.
In return, we offer a genuinely stable job, friendly clients, and an administration that is well-organized and helpful for you.
We also offer better employment terms than many other cleaning companies:
• Higher salary than in collective agreements
• Full-time work if you want to work full-time
• Compensation for travel by car or public transportation
• Work phone with free calls and free internet
• Bonus program for referrals to new clients and cleaners
• Healthcare/fitness subsidy
• Up to six weeks of vacation per year
The salary is 4% higher than in collective agreements, which currently means 161,87 SEK/h plus 12% vacation salary, for a total of 181,29 SEK/h.
If you're unfamiliar with the salary system in Sweden, it's worth noting that we, like all Swedish employers, also pay social fees of 31,42% on top of your salary. That includes your pension fee of 10,21%, which the Swedish state pays out to you when you retire, whether you then still live in Sweden or not.
To apply, you should:
1. Be motivated and skilled in home cleaning
2. Be reliable, friendly, and service-minded
3. Speak good Swedish or English (Please note that Swedish is NOT a requirement)
4. Hold a residence or work permit in Sweden
5. Plan to work with us at least 25% of full-time for at least 12 months
6. Be willing to show an extract from the Swedish criminal record register (Belastningsregistret)
Please note that having a driver’s license is NOT a requirement.
To learn more and apply online in less than three minutes, please visit homework.se/apply. We confirm, read, and reply to every single application.
We look forward to hearing from you.
Lön
161,87 SEK/h plus 12% vacation salary, that is, 181,29 SEK/h, plus other compensation listed above

**************************************

Professionell hemstädare hos HomeWork® AB
HomeWork® AB är ett av Sveriges största hemstädföretag, med kunder i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö och Lund. Vi har fokuserat uteslutande på hemstädning sedan 2007, det vill säga i mer än 19 år.
Som professionell hemstädare hos HomeWork städar du återkommande kunders hem varje, varannan eller var fjärde vecka. Du har normalt två kunder om dagen, ibland tre, men aldrig fler. Kunderna är desamma över tid och blir på så vis ”dina” kunder, som känner dig och litar på dig.
Vi söker medarbetare som är motiverade och genuint skickliga inom hemstädning: som kan sina material och metoder, arbetar noggrant och effektivt, är organiserade och har öga för detaljer. God kommunikation, servicekänsla och ansvarstagande är också viktigt. Om du har tidigare yrkeserfarenhet av städning är det en fördel, men inget krav.
Eftersom vi endast rekryterar personer som vill ha hemstädning som sitt yrke, ber vi dig att arbeta minst 25 % av heltid, alltså 10 timmar i veckan.
I gengäld erbjuder vi ett verkligt stabilt jobb, vänliga kunder och en administration som är välorganiserad och hjälpsam mot dig.
Vi erbjuder också bättre anställningsvillkor än många andra städföretag:
• Högre lön än i kollektivavtal
• Heltidsarbete om du vill arbeta heltid
• Ersättning för resa med bil eller kollektivtrafik
• Tjänstetelefon med fria samtal och fritt internet
• Bonusprogram för rekommendationer av nya kunder och städare
• Friskvårdsbidrag
• Upp till sex veckors semester per år
Lönen är 4% högre än i kollektivavtal, vilket för närvarande innebär 161,87 kr/h plus 12% semesterersättning, alltså totalt 181,29kr/h.
Om du inte känner till lönesystemet i Sverige, är det värt att notera att vi, liksom alla svenska arbetsgivare, också betalar sociala avgifter på 31,42 % utöver din lön. I det ingår din pensionsavgift på 10,21 %, som svenska staten betalar ut till dig när du går i pension, oavsett om du då bor kvar i Sverige eller inte.
För att söka bör du:
1. Vara motiverad och skicklig på hemstädning
2. Vara pålitlig, trevlig och serviceinriktad
3. Tala god svenska eller engelska (notera att svenska INTE är ett krav)
4. Ha uppehålls- eller arbetstillstånd i Sverige
5. Planera att arbeta hos oss minst 25 % av heltid i minst 12 månader
6. Vara beredd att uppvisa ett utdrag ur Belastningsregistret
Vänligen notera att ha ett körkort INTE är ett krav.
För att läsa mer och ansöka online på mindre än tre minuter, vänligen besök homework.se/apply. Vi bekräftar, läser och besvarar alla ansökningar.
Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig.
Lön
161,87 kr/h plus 12 % semesterersättning, alltså 181,29 kr/h, plus övriga ersättningar enligt ovan

TL;DR
You're a communications professional who can plan and execute the work that advances Lovable's objectives across EU and Swedish policy environments, making sure our voice is heard on the issues that matter most. You'll pair sharp corporate communications with real policy fluency — working closely with internal teams and external partners to help policymakers, media, and other stakeholders understand Lovable's perspective on the key files and issues that shape the environment we operate in.
This is a balanced role, equal parts policy operator and corporate communicator. You'll report to the European Communications and Public Affairs Lead.
Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
What you'll do
This role makes sure Lovable has a credible, constructive voice in the rooms that matter — building a presence worth listening to and developing clear positions that reflect what Lovable actually builds and believes.
Advocate Lovable's positions on key policy files. You'll build and run our engagement with policy representatives across EU and Swedish institutions.
Own corporate communications on policy issues. Statements, briefings, op-eds, speaking moments, and the proactive announcements that build credibility over time. You'll develop the strategy, write the materials, manage media relationships, and make sure each piece reinforces the others.
Track the regulatory agenda and turn it into a point of view. You'll monitor the files that affect us and develop clear positions that reflect the company's reality and ambitions.
Build coalitions and work through industry. You'll represent Lovable in trade associations and industry groups, finding shared causes that move issues forward.
Act as a comms and policy partner to our cross-functional team. You'll work closely with the communications and cross-functional teams in preparing for engagements with policymakers, institutions, and press, strengthening the company’s voice in the European AI debate.
Who you are
You've operated in and around the policy world. That might mean an EU institution, a trade association, a think tank, or a public affairs firm. Wherever you've been, you know how a file moves from idea to law, and you can read the politics, formal and informal, that determine what actually happens.
You understand policy and can communicate it. You have experience from both policy work and corporate communications, and you're equally comfortable speaking to policymakers and media alike.
You can drive an issue forward in a complex political environment. You're comfortable with ambiguity and competing agendas, and you know how to prioritize when everything feels urgent.
You're a sharp writer with editorial judgment. You can turn a dense regulatory development into a crisp briefing, opinion piece or clean position statement.
You connect dots that other people don't see. You look at a piece of draft legislation and think ahead on what it means for the industry as well as what Lovable should say and to whom.
You're a genuine cross-functional collaborator. You work easily with cross-functional stakeholders, external partners, and coalitions. You don't wait to be invited into the room. You're not precious about who gets credit. You just make things work.
You're deeply curious about AI, technology policy, and the industry landscape. You keep up with what happens in the world instinctively — the news, the regulatory moves, the debates as they unfold. You understand where the conversation is heading well enough to spot a risk or an opportunity before someone hands it to you.
What you need to know
This is not a role where you set the strategy and hand off execution. You'll be writing the first drafts of our position statements, building the relationships and showing up in the room as a Lovable representative.
We move fast and plans change. The job runs on two clocks at once: you'll react to the urgent issue that lands today while building the relationships and positions that set us up for success in the long term. If you need a settled environment with predictable workflows, this will be frustrating. If you find that kind of pace energizing, you'll love it.
We're building public affairs and communications at a company that is itself being built. That means you'll have real influence over how this function develops in Europe: the positions, the relationships, the standards. That's the upside of being early.
Finally: joining Lovable Comms means you're deeply curious, data-driven, and not extremely precious about role boundaries. You find ways to work smarter with AI, to measure what matters, and to step into work that isn't technically "yours" when the moment calls for it.
About your application
Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

Mycronic is a global high-tech company whose innovative solutions have been advancing electronics technology for over 40 years. Today we continue to grow and serve customers in an expanding variety of industries. What we do impacts the future of technology, and in turn, the way we live our lives tomorrow. We’re looking for people to join our talented, motivated and friendly team on the cutting-edge. Here, in an open, collaborative and flexible environment, you’ll work alongside leading industry experts and take on challenging projects that bring tomorrow’s electronics to life. If you have several years of work experience within software development and embedded systems and wants to be part of a growing company with world leading products, this is for you!
About the role
Mycronic has experienced strong growth in recent years, both organically and through acquisitions. With headquarters in Sweden, Mycronic is a global organization with subsidiaries, agents, and distributors in over 50 countries. Mycronic is divided into four divisions, and in this role, you will belong to PCB Assembly Solutions (PA). PA is a leading provider of equipment and solutions for surface mount technology (SMT) to electronics manufacturers who require rapid production adjustments while maintaining high efficiency. PA delivers systems for circuit board assembly, including both complete line solutions and individual systems for specific process steps, as well as advanced software for assembly process management and connected factories. In this role, you will be part of a team of 7 team members and collaborate with several functions across the company, such as architects, project managers and other software teams within for example AI.
You are offered
The opportunity to work in a multi-cultural company with knowledgeable, friendly and goal-oriented colleagues.
To work in an exciting company in a growth phase, where you can make a real impact in a fun and dynamic environment. Mycronic is a global company, yet small enough for you to truly make a difference.
The opportunity to work with world-leading products. The future of electronics production is increasingly complex. Denser boards, a wider range of miniaturized components, more NPIs and erratic production schedules. To address these challenges Mycronic has developed the industry’s fastest, most flexible and most precise jet printing and solder paste dispensing systems. Mycronic jet printing technology makes it possible to dispense solder paste for the most challenging circuit boards and components, with micrometer accuracy, maximum speed and perfect quality solder joints. Read more here: https://www.mycronic.com/product-areas/pcb-assembly/products/smt/jet-printing/.
Mycronic has a large software organization which will provide you with optimal opportunities to develop your knowledge in various areas of computer science – such as software architecture for robotics, machine learning, AI, optimization, and computer vision.

Work tasks
You will work in a broad developer role where you will truly have the opportunity to influence the final solution of the products. The Mycronic Jet Printer, which is the product area you will be developing the software for, includes electronics, mechanics, and software, creating exciting opportunities for those who want to work with complex software development involving multiple technical disciplines. We are continuously working to enhance our products; user-friendliness, particularly in terms of automation and user interfaces, which will also be part of your development work. Your primary focus will be on improving the products, with opportunities to contribute your ideas and collaborate as a team to create the best solutions. This may involve anything from adding capability features and reducing energy consumption to updating the GUI. Mycronic has both R&D, lab, and production in-house, meaning you will work close to the products you develop, which also gives you the opportunity to see the "real world" results of your work.
We are looking for
This is a role for someone with a strong background in software development and an interest in understanding the entire product and an ambition to grow into a software architect role. As a software developer you will have a key role in the product development since this is where all the technology in the machine comes together to provide the system functionality that meets the user. You will be involved in everything from requirements gathering to design, architecture and development and collaborate with several stakeholders. As a person, we see it as particularly important that you are goal- and detail-oriented and have strong collaboration skills. You also have a will to contribute with your ideas, and just like your colleagues, you always strive to develop yourself and contribute to the team´s collective growth. We expect you to make a strong contribution by adding new functionality, maintaining high quality and by helping to introduce new technology and processes to increase team efficiency.
You likely have:
A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, electronics, mechatronics, or a similar field.
Strong software development experience with the capability and ambition to take on broader architectural responsibilities in a few years.
Knowledge in Java.
Strong knowledge of software development in Linux.
Experience of working with software systems that interact with embedded software and hardware.
Strong knowledge in English and good knowledge in Swedish (or have the desire to learn)

It is considered advantageous if you have: 
Knowledge in C and/or C++

Other Information
Start date: By agreement
Employment type: Permanent
Scope: Full-time
Location: Kista
Contact Information: Senior Recruitment Consultant Johanna Sörell, johanna.sorell@academicwork.se
The recruitment process is handled by Academic Work, and Mycronic requests that all questions regarding the process goes to Academic Work.

Our recruitment process
Problem-solving and personality test
Phone interview with Academic Work
In-depth interview with Academic Work
Interviews with Mycronic
Reference check + decision

Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
What this role is and what it isn’t
It is a senior are lead role with scope. You’ll run an organization that spans product, platform, and applied AI - with other managers, senior engineers, and AI agents reporting in - and you’ll be accountable for what that organization ships, how it operates, and the business outcomes it drives.
It is still close enough to the work that you can drop into a Tech Lead role on a hard problem when the situation demands it. We don’t measure leadership IC time as a percentage. We measure it as the ability to pick up the work and ship at the bar you’re asking of your team.
It isn’t a role for managers who think of themselves as engineering-adjacent. You need to be credible in code, design, and on-call - and you need to want to be.
It isn’t a role for leaders who only think about engineering. We expect you to reason end-to-end about the business - economics, product, GTM, customers - and to make calls that are best for the company, not just best for your team.

What we’re looking for
15+ years of engineering experience, including 6+ years of people management at a pre-IPO startup, scale-up or frontier tech company, and at least 2 years of managing managers. Strong IC track record before management.
You’ve run an engineering organization of 30+ with managers and senior engineers reporting in. You can speak concretely about how you structured the org, how you hired up to that scale, and what you’d do differently.
Still hands-on at the Tech Lead level: you can pick up an unfamiliar codebase, design and ship a non-trivial change, run an incident, and review code at a high bar. You haven’t let your engineering muscle atrophy.
You’ve thought hard about humans and AI agents on the same team. What humans should and shouldn’t delegate. How productivity gets measured when the unit of work is shifting. Strong opinions, lightly held.
Comfortable navigating ambiguity and driving clarity at an organisational level, not just technically. You write the doc that aligns three teams instead of waiting for someone else to.
Deep technical credibility in at least one area - full-stack product (React/TypeScript + Go/Rust), platform and developer experience (Kubernetes, sandboxing, observability, CI/CD, application frameworks), or applied AI (training, evals, agent systems, model serving).
Cross-functional to your core and business-fluent: you work seamlessly across design, product, and go-to-market, and know how to bring people along with you; andable to reason end-to-end about unit economics, product strategy, GTM, and customer outcomes
Track record of building and growing teams: you’ve hired senior engineers others wanted to work with, grown managers under you who became great in their own right, and set up career growth and performance practices that didn’t require constant maintenance. People follow you between companies.
Based in Stockholm or London or ready to relocate — this is an on-site, 5-days-a-week role.

What you’ll do
In one sentence: Run the engineering organization that builds Lovable - humans and agents both - and stay close enough to the work to be the senior engineer in the room when it matters.
Lead engineering. Product, platform, and applied AI under one roof. Own the roadmap and the business outcomes the org is on the hook for.
Set technical direction across the org: drive the design docs and architectural decisions that span teams, push back hard on weak plans (including your own), and hold a high bar for what ships.
Shape engineering culture: how we ship, how we write code, how we hire, how we deploy agents. Set norms that outlast any single project.
Ship fast: at Lovable the question is always “how fast can we get this to users?” You bias toward production and pull research, prototypes, and experiments into reality on the order of days and weeks, not quarters.
Build the operating model for an engineering org where humans and AI agents work side by side. We’re inventing this in public, and you’ll set the patterns the rest of the company learns from.
Operate as a peer to the executive team. Own outcomes that span beyond engineering, make the company’s biggest calls alongside the rest of leadership, and translate them back into engineering work that matters.

Our tech stack
We’re building with tools that both humans and AI love:
Frontend: React, TypeScript
Backend: Go and Rust
Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, many LLM providers
Data: ClickHouse, Firestore, Spanner, BigQuery
DevOps & tooling: Kubernetes, gVisor-based sandboxing for agentic workloads, GitHub Actions, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Terraform
Local tooling: Nix, DevEnv

About your application
Please submit your application in English — it’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
We treat all candidates equally — if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

 Ready to join us?
Help us unlock human creativity and build the future of software creation.

jobs.occupation: Cyber Security Unit Manager - Cyber, Risk & Assurance
jobs.employer_name: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
jobs.description:
Job Description

As Unit Manager for Cyber Risk & Assurance, you will lead H&M Group’s capabilities for cyber risk management, governance, compliance and assurance, playing a key role in strengthening the organisation’s security, resilience and ability to manage cyber risk in line with its risk appetite and regulatory obligations. 
As a member of the Cyber Security Leadership Team reporting to the CISO, you will share accountability for the overall cyber security strategy, priorities and long-term development of the Cyber Security function. Working closely with leaders across business, technology and cyber security, you will help shape outcomes that balance business objectives, security needs and risk management across H&M Group. 
You will provide strategic leadership for H&M Group’s Cyber Risk & Assurance capability, bringing together Cyber Security Frameworks, Supply Chain Security Risk and Security Control Assurance. Through your leadership, you will drive the continued evolution of cyber risk management and control assurance. 
WHAT YOU WILL DO
Lead the strategic direction, maturity and long-term development of H&M Group’s Cyber, Risk & Assurance capability, defining and evolving the strategy, roadmap and operating model in alignment with business, technology and cyber security objectives. 
Contribute as a member of the Cyber Security Leadership Team to the overall cyber security strategy, priorities and long-term capability development. 
Drive the continued development and maturity of the Information Security Management System (ISMS), including frameworks, policies and governance structures that enable consistent and effective management of cyber risk across H&M Group. 
Provide oversight and assurance of cyber security risks and controls, promoting transparency, accountability and effective risk-based decision-making. 
Strengthen H&M Group’s approach to security policy and compliance, regulatory requirements, security control assurance and governance reporting. 
Drive the continued development of third-party and supply chain security risk management, ensuring risks are identified, assessed and managed through effective governance and oversight. 
Lead budgeting, resource and investment planning, vendor strategy and prioritisation to support Cyber Risk & Assurance and wider cyber security objectives. 
Foster a high-performing, collaborative and inclusive culture focused on strong accountability, continuous improvement and business value. 

Leadership as a Unit Manager  
As a Unit Manager and member of the Cyber Security Leadership Team, you provide strategic leadership for your unit while contributing to the overall direction and development of the Cyber Security function. You develop high-performing leadership teams, drive organisational effectiveness and capability development. You demonstrate enterprise leadership by collaborating across the business, influencing senior stakeholders and supporting decisions that create value beyond your own unit. 
WHO YOU ARE
We are looking for someone with: 
8+ years of people management experience in cyber security, technology risk, governance, compliance, assurance or a closely related field. 
Proven experience leading enterprise-scale cyber risk, governance, compliance or assurance capabilities in a complex global organisation. 
Proven experience leading through managers and developing high-performing leadership teams, with accountability for a multidisciplinary organisation and its outcomes. 
Experience as a member of a senior cyber security, technology, risk or enterprise leadership team, contributing to shared strategy, priorities, investment decisions and organisational outcomes beyond your own area of responsibility. 
Strong knowledge of cyber security risk management, governance, compliance and assurance principles, methodologies and operating models. 
Strong knowledge of security frameworks, policies, standards and controls, and experience translating regulatory and internal requirements into effective security governance. 
Strong understanding of third-party and supply chain security risk management in complex global environments. 
Experience establishing meaningful cyber risk, governance and assurance metrics and translating risk and control information into clear business implications, priorities and decisions. 
Experience managing significant budgets, investments, resources, sourcing arrangements and external partners, including strategic vendor relationships. 
Excellent communication and influencing skills, with proven experience engaging senior and executive stakeholders and communicating complex cyber risk, regulatory and assurance topics in a clear and pragmatic way. 
Sound judgement and decision-making capability in complex, uncertain and risk-sensitive situations. 

 

Additional Information

This is a fulltime permanent role based in Stockholm, Sweden. 
If you believe your experience, skills, and ambitions align with this role, please submit your CV in English.
Diversity, Inclusion, and Innovation 
At H&M Group, we're deeply committed to fostering a Diverse & Inclusive environment. We actively seek out qualified candidates regardless of race, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, national origin, disability, or age. 
Our commitment to an inclusive workplace drives our dynamic and forward-thinking culture. Regardless of your background, origin, or preferences, your application is warmly welcomed. We value diverse perspectives and skills, and every applicant contributes to our vibrant, creative community. Join us and be part of the future we're building. 
Our Offer 
At H&M Group, you're not just joining a team – you're joining a value-driven culture and an expansive tech network. Enjoy perks like staff discount cards, flexible work arrangements, wellness benefits, parental support, and more. Here, you're encouraged to be yourself, experiment, and chart your own growth path. As you flourish, so do we, with opportunities to create tangible impacts and shape the future. 
WHO WE ARE​ 
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​ 
​We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​ 
​WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE ​ 
We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here. 
In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries. 
JOIN US​ 
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​ 
​Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​ 
​ *We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.​

At Stegra, we’re not just building a plant, we’re proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you.
Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life.
Role Overview
Stegra is seeking a highly experienced and strategic Lead Legal Counsel – Project Finance to join our Legal team and take a leading role in supporting the company's large-scale project debt financing, together with related corporate and compliance work. This role will play a critical part in shaping and executing our debt financing strategy, ensuring compliance, and safeguarding the company’s legal and commercial interests across all debt-related matters.
Reporting to the Head of Legal – Corporate Finance & Company Secretary, and working closely and with support from the Corporate Finance Legal Counsel, you will take primary day-to-day ownership of the legal workstreams underpinning the company's large project financing package, including its ECA and public funding arrangements, multi-tranche lender structures, and security package.
This is an opportunity for an experienced, commercially-minded lawyer who wants to take ownership of a sophisticated and high-profile project finance capital stack, working directly with senior stakeholders on some of the company's most important legal and financial matters. The role carries substantial responsibility and autonomy, with significant scope to shape how project finance legal support is delivered as the company scales.
As Stegra continues to grow, the role offers significant exposure to a broad range of legal and finance matters, close collaboration with internal and external senior stakeholders and executive leadership, and the opportunity to mentor more junior members of the legal team on project finance matters.
Key Responsibilities
As a fast-growing company with cross-over functions between teams, the scope of this role will evolve, however, core responsibilities include:
· Legal Strategy for Debt Financing: Developing, implementing, and maintaining the legal strategy for the company's project and corporate debt financing, in close collaboration with the finance and executive leadership teams.
· Document Negotiation & Drafting: Leading the drafting, negotiation, and execution of legal documentation related to debt financing, including loan agreements, intercreditor agreements, security documents, engagement letters, and other financing-related contracts.
· Stakeholder Coordination: Acting as a primary legal point of contact for debt financing activities, coordinating with internal stakeholders (finance, tax, project delivery, treasury) and external parties (lenders, law firms, consultants, and regulatory bodies).
· Compliance Oversight: Ensuring ongoing compliance with debt-related legal obligations, covenants, and regulatory requirements, and coordinating internal processes to monitor compliance and reporting duties under financing agreements.
· Risk Management: Identifying and mitigating legal risks related to financing structures, securities, and credit support instruments, and providing legal guidance to support informed, risk-based decision-making.
Additional Responsibilities:
· Overseeing covenant compliance processes across multiple lending tranches.
· Coordinating the direct agreement workstream with project counterparties, including EPC, O&M and offtake counterparties, and supporting intercreditor arrangements and multi-party lender coordination.
· Liaising efficiently with lenders' counsel, ECA counsel, technical advisers, insurance advisers, and other external specialists under tight drawdown deadlines.
· Building and maintaining strong relationships with internal stakeholders (finance, tax, treasury, project delivery) and external parties (lenders, investors, law firms, ECAs, and regulatory bodies) on financing-related matters.
· Preparing summaries and reports on financing status, risks, and compliance for internal stakeholders and management.
· Assisting in the preparation of board materials and approvals related to debt financing.
· Supporting the Head of Legal in developing scalable legal processes, templates, and playbooks for the company's project debt financing operations as it grows.
· Providing guidance and oversight to more junior legal team members working on project finance matters, as needed.
Minimum Qualifications
· We are looking for candidates who meet the following criteria:
· A Master of Laws (LL.M. or equivalent) with strong academic credentials.
· Minimum 8 years of relevant legal experience at a leading law firm, within project finance, banking and finance, or capital markets. Relevant in-house experience is also a merit.
· Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex transactional workstreams, from term sheet to complete documentation through drafting, negotiation, and execution, with minimal supervision.
· Strong analytical and drafting skills, with a commercial mindset and sound judgment on risk-based decision-making.
· Effective communication and stakeholder management skills across both legal and finance functions, including engagement with senior leadership.
· Demonstrated ability to manage and organize high-volume transactional document sets, maintain accurate tracking of open items and workstream status, and coordinate effectively across multiple external advisers simultaneously, particularly under deadline-driven transaction timelines.
· A collaborative team player, comfortable working across related financing disciplines and supporting the development of more junior colleagues.
· Fluency in English (written and spoken); additional languages are a plus.
What Will Set You Apart
· Substantial experience in project finance, structured finance, or capital-intensive projects.
· Familiarity with export credit agency (ECA) or public funding financing structures.
· Familiarity with project finance security structures, including pledges, assignments of contract rights, and direct agreements, and with intercreditor or coordination agreement mechanics in multi-tranche lending structures.
· Experience negotiating directly with lenders, ECAs, and their counsel on complex, multi-party financings.
· Experience in corporate or equity financing transactions and M&A, providing broader context across the company's financing activities.
· Experience with company secretarial or corporate governance matters.
· Prior experience mentoring or supervising junior legal team members.
Personal Qualities
We value people who take initiative, build trust, and contribute to a collaborative workplace. You are curious, open to challenging established approaches, and treat others with respect. You are proactive, adaptable, results-driven, and able to prioritize and work independently with full ownership of your responsibilities, while also being ready to guide and support more junior colleagues.
As a person you are likely independent, resilient, proactive and organized. You like to solve complex problems, work in a highly complex environment and have the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and evolving business environment.
Our Stockholm Office
Our modern Stockholm office is located on Norra Stationsgatan, close to Karolinska University Hospital in central Stockholm. Here, you’ll find a bright, collaborative workspace where cross-functional teams connect, share ideas, and drive progress. Whether you're visiting regularly or working hybrid, you'll be part of a vibrant office culture with easy access to the city’s energy and amenities.

jobs.occupation: Mechanical Engineer  From CAD Clean-up to Next-Generation Boat Design
jobs.description: Mechanical Engineer“Make X Shore’s CAD data something production can build from without guessing. Audit and rebuild assemblies, align them with the factory floor, and then help design the next-generation boat.”About the RoleX Shore’s existing CAD models and assemblies don’t fully reflect what’s actually being built on the factory floor — data has drifted from production reality, making it hard to trust drawings, plan rework, or hand off clean information to manufacturing. We’re looking for a Mechanical Engineer to audit and rebuild that CAD data, get it aligned with how boats are actually produced, and then move on to design work on X Shore’s next-generation boat platform.This is a hands-on role in two phases. First, you’ll dig into existing CAD, correct what’s out of sync with production, and work closely with the shop floor to close the gap between design intent and built reality. Once that foundation is solid, you’ll shift into forward-looking platform design for future boats. You’ll report to the Mechanical Engineering & Analysis Manager and be based on-site in Nyköping.Key Responsibilities    Audit existing CAD models and assemblies for accuracy, completeness, and structure    Rebuild or correct CAD data that no longer reflects what’s actually being built in production    Align CAD assemblies and drawings with current production reality, working directly with the shop floor    Identify and resolve discrepancies between design intent and manufactured parts    Maintain clean, well-structured CAD/PDM practices going forward    Support production with drawings, tolerances, and design clarifications during rework and manufacturing    Once alignment work is complete, contribute to the design and detailing of X Shore’s next-generation boat platform    Collaborate with electrical, production, and manufacturing engineering teams to ensure designs are manufacturableRequired Qualifications    Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent practical experience    3-5+ years of experience in mechanical design, ideally in a manufacturing environment    Expert-level SOLIDWORKS proficiency — this is a must-have, including assemblies, drawings, and PDM    Demonstrated experience auditing, cleaning up, or rebuilding CAD data and assemblies    Comfortable working directly with production to resolve build discrepancies    Fluent in English; Swedish is a plus    Ability to work on-site in NyköpingDesirable Qualifications    Experience with composites and/or metals typical of marine or automotive manufacturing    Background in boat building, automotive, or another complex hardware environment    Familiarity with GD&T and tolerance stack-up analysis    Experience contributing to a new product platform from early concept through releasePersonal QualitiesDetail-oriented and methodical, comfortable untangling messy legacy data without losing momentum. Equally at home on the shop floor verifying fit as at a CAD workstation. Takes ownership, follows through, and communicates clearly across engineering and production.Success Metrics (First 12 Months)    CAD data and assemblies for existing boats are audited, corrected, and aligned with what’s built in production    Production has accurate, trustworthy drawings and models to work from    Discrepancies between design and manufactured parts are identified and resolved    Meaningful contribution made to next-generation boat platform designLocation & StructureOn-site at X Shore Factory & HQ, Nyköping. Reports to the Mechanical Engineering & Analysis Manager.

jobs.occupation: Senior Product Manager - Stockholm or Hudiksvall
jobs.description: Want to tackle complex customer problems, shape product strategy, and turn insight into measurable impact? Come and join us as a Senior Product Manager.About the RoleWe’re looking for a Senior Product Manager who combines strategic thinking with hands-on product leadership. You’ll shape the vision and strategy for your product area and turn customer insights into measurable customer and business outcomes. You’ll lead your Product Trio and the work of your empowered cross-functional team through expertise, influence, and collaboration, without formal people-management responsibilities.What You’ll DoProduct Leadership    Set the vision and strategy for your product area.    Lead discovery and delivery with your Product Trio and cross functional team.    Use customer insights and data to define impactful solutions.    Set success metrics and ensure measurable outcomes.    Align stakeholders across commercial, technical, and customer-facing teams.    Lead through influence and champion modern product practices.You’ll often lead your team remotely rather than work together in person day to day, making strong communication and trust-building essential.Who You AreTo succeed in this role, you bring strategic thinking, strong collaboration skills, and a natural drive to move things forward. We place more weight on your personal qualities than on having the “perfect” resume.You are:    A strong collaborator who builds trust and brings people together.    Confident in making decisions, even in complex situations.    Proactive and self‑driven, with a strong sense of ownership.    Strategic, analytical, and able to prioritise what matters most.    Goal- and results-oriented with the energy to drive progress.    A supportive, inclusive leader who develops and coaches others.    Guided by integrity and empathy, fostering a positive and safe environment.What You BringWe believe the right mindset and personal qualities matter most. But to thrive, you likely have:    Experience as a Product Manager working with modern product development.    Curiosity and drive. You make things happen rather than wait for direction.    Strong communication skills in English; Swedish is an advantage.    Experience with SaaS, the Product Operating Model, or Agile frameworks is a plus.    Experience working with AI coding assistants and context repositories is a plus.Who We AreWe are Bjorn Lunden, the business platform that simplifies everyday life for small and medium-sized businesses. Our belief is simple: every business deserves opportunities to grow, and we’re here to make that happen 🐻.We’re on an exciting journey. With bold ambitions, our vision is to become one of the leading providers of accounting and financial software solutions in Northwestern Europe. With our roots in Hälsingland, specifically in the small village of Näsviken, we’ve grown rapidly in recent years, transforming from a smaller national company into an international group. Today, we operate in Sweden, the Netherlands, and Denmark.Our goal is straightforward: to make life a little easier for entrepreneurs and business owners. We believe we can do that through great software, knowledge, innovation, and TACO. Not the kind you might be thinking of - but our version: Trust, Ambition, Collaboration, and Ownership.What We OfferWe offer you a role in an international, growing company with a strong market position and the ambition to challenge industry giants. The wellbeing of our employees truly matters to us, and we want to be a fair and responsible employer where people feel good and enjoy their work.We strive for a healthy work-life balance and support this through competitive conditions and benefits and flexible work opportunities. We want to be the natural first choice for people who want to thrive and have fun at work.ApplicationThis is a full-time, permanent position based in Stockholm or Hudiksvall. Application deadline is 13th December 2026, but selection and interviews may take place on an ongoing basis. The position may therefore be filled before the deadline, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.For questions, feel free to contact: Johan Lindahl, Head of Product Management johan.lindahl@bjornlunden.com *For this recruitment, we kindly ask that recruitment agencies or other external partners refrain from contacting us.
